requirements.title: Required Courses (6 credits)
requirements.sourceText: Required Courses (6 credits) - COM 100 - Introduction to Communication 3 credits - COM 120 - Fundamentals of Public Speaking 3 credits

requirements.label: choose-one
requirements.title: Choose one of the following courses (3 credits)
requirements.sourceText: Choose one of the following courses (3 credits) - COM 202 - Intercultural Communication 3 credits - COM 206 - Interpersonal Communication 3 credits

requirements.label: electives
requirements.title: Electives
requirements.sourceText: Choose three of the following electives at or above the 300 level (9 credits) - COM 314 - Communication Research 3 credits - COM 315 - Communication Theory 3 credits - COM 351 - Team Collaboration and Community Engagement 3 credits - COM 357 - Health Communication 3 credits - COM 358 - Nonverbal Communication 3 credits - COM 346 - Race, Class, and Gender in Media 3 credits - COM 365 - Talking Science 3 credits - COM 386 - Special Topics: Issues in Communication 3 credits - COM 400 - Advanced Communication Research 3 credits - COM 401 - Organizational Communication 3 credits - COM 402 - Crisis Communication 3 credits - COM 403 - Strategic Communication 3 credits - COM 404 - Communication for Social Change & Public Advocacy 3 credits - COM 405 - Political Communication 3 credits - COM 406 - Risk Communication 3 credits - COM 407 - Social Media Analytics 3 credits - COM 415 - Data Analysis and Storytelling 3 credits - COM 436 - Environmental Communication 3 credits
